data.name: Welcome
data.value: 🕯 A little light for someone who matters. Candle is a place to light a candle in memory of someone, to offer support, or to share a wish. Add a few words, choose a background and share your candle. Others can help keep its flame alive. Your next little light starts here.

data.name: Help
data.value: 🕯 Your first candle 1. Open Candle Sign in and select “New candle”. 2. Make it yours Add a message and, if you like, a background image. Then light your candle. 3. Share a little light Send the candle link to someone. Tap a burning candle to help it stay alight. Candles and their messages are public. Share only what you want others to see.
